description: Organic mechanisms decomposed. SN1/SN2/E1/E2, electrophilic addition, nucleophilic addition, electrophilic aromatic substitution, radical reactions, organometallic, named reactions (Grignard, aldol, Diels-Alder), retrosynthesis.

sub_mechanisms.name: SN2_mechanism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Concerted backside attack. Inversion of stereochemistry. Rate = k[substrate][nucleophile].
sub_mechanisms.why: 1° + good nucleophile + polar aprotic solvent. Inversion = Walden inversion. Standard organic.

sub_mechanisms.name: SN1_carbocation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Stepwise. Substrate ionises to carbocation; nucleophile attacks. Racemisation.
sub_mechanisms.why: 3° substrate + polar protic solvent. Carbocation stability: 3° > 2° > 1°. Standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: E2_elimination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Concerted. Anti-periplanar H + leaving group eliminate. Forms alkene.
sub_mechanisms.why: Strong base + 2°/3° substrate. Zaitsev's rule: more substituted alkene. Stereospecific.

sub_mechanisms.name: E1_elimination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Stepwise via carbocation. Weak base + 3° substrate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Same carbocation as SN1. Competes with SN1. Product = alkene (Saytzeff).

sub_mechanisms.name: electrophilic_addition_alkene
sub_mechanisms.definition: Alkene + electrophile (HBr, Br2). Markovnikov: H to C with more H. Anti-Markovnikov (peroxide).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation alkene chemistry. Halogenation, hydration, hydrohalogenation. Standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: EAS_aromatic_substitution
sub_mechanisms.definition: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution. Arene + electrophile. Sigma complex intermediate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Benzene reactions. Nitration, halogenation, Friedel-Crafts. Substituent effects (ortho/para vs meta).

sub_mechanisms.name: nucleophilic_addition_carbonyl
sub_mechanisms.definition: C=O + nucleophile → alcohol or related. Aldehydes more reactive than ketones.
sub_mechanisms.why: Grignard, hydride reductions, aldol, etc. Foundation of carbonyl chemistry.

sub_mechanisms.name: Grignard_reaction
sub_mechanisms.definition: R-MgX + carbonyl → alcohol. RMgX prepared from R-X + Mg.
sub_mechanisms.why: Forms C-C bonds. Foundation of organic synthesis. Versatile. Sensitive to water + air.

sub_mechanisms.name: aldol_reaction
sub_mechanisms.definition: Enolate + carbonyl → β-hydroxyaldehyde/ketone. Often followed by dehydration to enone.
sub_mechanisms.why: C-C bond formation. Common in natural product synthesis + biology (citric acid cycle).

sub_mechanisms.name: Diels_Alder
sub_mechanisms.why: Powerful ring formation. Nobel 1950. Used in steroid + terpene synthesis. Concerted via cyclic TS.

sub_mechanisms.name: radical_chain_reactions
sub_mechanisms.definition: Initiation, propagation, termination. Halogenation of alkanes.
sub_mechanisms.why: Industrial: polyethylene polymerisation, chlorination. Atmospheric chemistry (ozone). Foundation.

sub_mechanisms.name: retrosynthesis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Plan backward from target. Disconnect bonds; identify synthons + reagents.
sub_mechanisms.why: Corey's framework. Foundation of synthesis design. Computer-aided synthesis tools now leverage. Nobel 1990.

derivation_rules.name: SN1_vs_SN2_substrate_dependence
derivation_rules.why: 3° carbocation stable; steric hindrance to backside attack. 1°: opposite. 2°: depends on conditions. Foundation.

derivation_rules.name: Markovnikov_via_more_stable_carbocation
then: H goes to less substituted C (more stable carbocation forms)
derivation_rules.why: Carbocation stability: 3° > 2° > 1°. Mechanism follows lowest energy path. Universal addition rule.

derivation_rules.name: Diels_Alder_concerted_stereospecific
then: stereochemistry of diene + dienophile preserved in product
derivation_rules.why: Concerted: no intermediate. cis-dienophile → cis-product. Endo preferred (secondary orbital interactions). Standard.

derivation_rules.name: retrosynthesis_starts_from_target
derivation_rules.why: Forward: combinatorial explosion. Backward: focused on bonds in target. Corey's method. Standard modern synthesis.

derivation_rules.name: EAS_substituents_direct_position
then: next EAS goes ortho/para (activating) or meta (deactivating)
derivation_rules.why: OR, NR2: o/p directors + activators. NO2, COOH: m directors + deactivators. Resonance + induction. Standard.
